# Commands

Every command accepts `--json`. Per-command error codes: `graph describe commands --json`.

## graph apply

Apply change set documents (JSON or JSONL) from a file or stdin.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: none. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph apply FILE [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes | no | Path of the input, or - for stdin. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate every document without writing. |
| `--summary` | flag | no | no | Per document only counts, seq and findings: entities is null, entity_count stays. |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe; single document only, else idempotency_key in each document. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph apply - --json` | Apply documents from stdin. |
| `graph apply <file> --dry-run --json` | Check a file without writing. |
| `graph apply <file> --summary --json` | Apply a large file, findings without the list. |

## graph create

Create one entity of a type.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.create`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph create TYPE [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | term | yes | no | Type CURIE. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--set` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value, coerced by the attribute's datatype; <value>@en names a language. |
| `--set-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, a typed value. |
| `--edge` | assignment | no | yes | relation=<id>: an outgoing edge. |
| `--valid-from` | string | no | no | Start of validity: date or RFC 3339 timestamp. |
| `--valid-to` | string | no | no | End of validity: date or RFC 3339 timestamp. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph create <type> --set <attr>=<value>` | Create with one attribute. |
| `graph create <type> --set <attr>=<value> --edge <relation>=<id> --dry-run --json` | Preview the result. |

## graph file add

Store a file as a files:File entity; known content is not stored twice.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.create`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph file add PATH [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | file | yes | no | The file to store. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | term | no | no | files:File or a subclass of it. |
| `--title` | string | no | no | Name for people; the file name without extension. |
| `--set` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value, coerced by the attribute's datatype; <value>@en names a language. |
| `--set-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, a typed value. |
| `--media-type` | string | no | no | Media type instead of the detected one. |
| `--source-url` | string | no | no | Address the file was downloaded from. |
| `--retrieved-at` | string | no | no | Date of the download, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `--no-origin` | flag | no | no | Do not record where the file came from. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph file add <file>` | Store a file. |
| `graph file add <file> --type <type> --title <value> --json` | Store it as a subclass with a title. |

## graph find

Find entities by type, field filters and relations; paged.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.find`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph find [OPTIONS]`

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | term | no | yes | Type CURIE or unique local name, subtypes included. |
| `--where` | filter | no | yes | attr=value or attr:op=value (ne lt le gt ge contains prefix in exists lang). |
| `--rel` | string | no | yes | Outgoing relation, optionally =<id>[,<id>...]. |
| `--in-rel` | string | no | yes | Incoming relation, optionally =<id>[,<id>...]. |
| `--include-inactive` | flag | no | no | Include superseded and retracted entities. |
| `--sort` | string | no | yes | Field to sort by, optionally :desc. |
| `--fields` | string | no | yes | Only these fields (comma-separated): attributes, edges or system fields; id, alias, type, rev and record_status always. |
| `--limit` | integer | no | no | Page size, at most 500. Default: `50`. |
| `--offset` | integer | no | no | Skip this many results. Default: `0`. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read the state after tx:<seq>, or at an RFC 3339 time; needs history access. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `limit` | 500 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph find --type <type> --where <attr>=<value>` | Filter by a field. |
| `graph find --type <type> --fields <attr> --json` | Only one field of each entity. |
| `graph find --type <type> --rel <relation>=<id> --json` | Filter by a relation. |
| `graph find --type <type> --rel <relation>=<id>,<id> --json` | An edge to any of the listed entities. |
| `graph find --type <type> --as-of tx:<seq> --json` | The entities of a type as they were after that tx. |

## graph get

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.get`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph get REF [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rev` | integer | no | no | Show this earlier revision instead of the current one. |
| `--fields` | string | no | yes | Only these fields (comma-separated): attributes, edges or system fields; id, alias, type, rev and record_status always. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read the state after tx:<seq>, or at an RFC 3339 time; needs history access. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph get <id>` | Show one entity. |

| `graph get <id> --fields <attr>,edges --json` | Only one field and the edges. |
| `graph get <id> --as-of tx:<seq> --json` | The entity as it was after that tx. |

## graph lookup

Find entities by name: main, alternative and hidden labels; ranked candidates.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.find`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph lookup TEXT... [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | yes | The names to look for, one per argument. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | term | no | yes | Type CURIE or unique local name, subtypes included. |
| `--match` | choice | no | no | Whole name, or names that start with the text. One of `exact`, `prefix`. Default: `exact`. |
| `--ignore-accents` | flag | no | no | Also match with accents and other combining marks ignored. |
| `--include-inactive` | flag | no | no | Include superseded and retracted entities. |
| `--lang` | string | no | no | Only names in this language (a BCP 47 tag or range such as de, or *); also picks the shown label. |
| `--limit` | integer | no | no | Page size, at most 500. Default: `50`. |
| `--offset` | integer | no | no | Skip this many results. Default: `0`. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read the state after tx:<seq>, or at an RFC 3339 time; needs history access. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `limit` | 500 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph lookup <value>` | Entities named exactly so, any type. |
| `graph lookup <value> '<value> <value>' --json` | Several names in one call, one per argument. |
| `graph lookup <value> --type <type> --match prefix --json` | Names of one type that start with the text. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rel` | term | no | yes | Only these relations. |
| `--direction` | choice | no | no | Edge direction. One of `out`, `in`, `both`. Default: `both`. |
| `--depth` | integer | no | no | Hops, 1 to 3. Default: `1`. |
| `--fields` | string | no | yes | Only these fields (comma-separated): attributes, edges or system fields; id, alias, type, rev and record_status always. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read the state after tx:<seq>, or at an RFC 3339 time; needs history access. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `depth` | 3 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph neighbors <id>` | Direct neighbors. |
| `graph neighbors <id> --rel <relation> --direction out --depth 2 --json` | Two hops along one relation. |

## graph query

Answer a read-only Cypher query: several hops, OR/NOT across relations, counts.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.query`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph query [TEXT] [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | no | no | The query, or - to read it from stdin. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | file | no | no | Read the query from this file. |
| `--param` | assignment | no | yes | name=value binds $name; the value is JSON when it parses, else text. |
| `--include-inactive` | flag | no | no | Include superseded and retracted entities. |
| `--explain` | flag | no | no | Show the resolved query; run nothing. |
| `--limit` | integer | no | no | Rows per page, at most 500. Default: `50`. |
| `--offset` | integer | no | no | Skip this many rows. Default: `0`. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read the state after tx:<seq>, or at an RFC 3339 time; needs history access. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `limit` | 500 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph query 'MATCH (n:<type>)-[:<relation>]->(m) RETURN n, m.<attr>' --json` | Entities with the entities they point to. |
| `graph query 'MATCH (n:<type>) WHERE NOT (n)-[:<relation>]->() RETURN n' --json` | Entities without an outgoing edge of one relation. |
| `graph query 'MATCH (n:<type>)-[:<relation>]->(m) RETURN m.<attr>, count(n) AS sources ORDER BY sources DESC' --json` | Counts per target. |
| `graph query --file <file> --param id=<id> --json` | A query from a file with a parameter. |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `--dir` | directory | no | no | Project directory for --scope project; default: the working directory. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | yes | Also the skill of this graph (name or id); repeatable. |
| `--force` | flag | no | no | Replace skill directories that are not ours or were edited by hand. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Show what would be installed; write nothing. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph skills install --scope project --dir <dir>` | Into one project. |
| `graph skills install --scope user --graph <graph> --json` | For every project of the user, with one graph skill. |
| `graph skills install --scope project --dry-run --json` | Show the plan. |

## graph supersede

Replace entities by another one; needs --reason.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.supersede`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph supersede BY TARGETS... [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `by` | entity_ref | yes | no | The replacement. |
| `targets` | entity_ref | yes | yes | Entities it replaces. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph supersede <id> <id> --reason <value>` | One replaces another. |
| `graph supersede <id> <id> <id> --reason <value> --json` | One replaces two. |

## graph transition

Move an entity's lifecycle to another state.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.transition`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph transition REF STATE [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |
| `state` | string | yes | no | Target state. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--attr` | string | no | no | Lifecycle attribute, if the type has several. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph transition <id> <state>` | Change the state. |
| `graph transition <id> <state> --dry-run --json` | Check guards without writing. |

## graph unlink

Remove an edge by relation and target, or by edge id.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.unlink`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph unlink REF [REL] [TARGET] [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |
| `rel` | term | no | no | Relation CURIE. |
| `target` | entity_ref | no | no | Target id, alias or id suffix. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--edge-id` | string | no | no | The edge id instead of REL and TARGET. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph unlink <id> <relation> <id>` | Remove the edge to a target. |
| `graph unlink <id> --edge-id <id> --json` | Remove one edge by id. |

## graph update

Set, unset, add to or remove from attributes of one entity.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.update`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph update REF [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--set` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value, coerced by the attribute's datatype; <value>@en names a language. |
| `--set-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, a typed value. |
| `--unset` | string | no | yes | Attribute to remove. |
| `--add` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value appended to a list attribute unless present; coerced by datatype. |
| `--add-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, one typed value to add. |
| `--remove` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value dropped from a list attribute; coerced by datatype. |
| `--remove-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, one typed value to remove. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph update <id> --set <attr>=<value>` | Change one attribute. |
| `graph update <id> --add <attr>=<value> --dry-run --json` | Add one value to a list, no read needed. |
| `graph update <id> --unset <attr> --expect 3 --json` | Remove one, guarded by revision. |

## graph whoami

Show who is acting: the identity facets and what the policy allows.

Kind: meta. Surface: meta. Action: none. Exit codes: 0, 2, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph whoami`

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph whoami` | Show the acting identity. |
| `graph whoami --json` | The identity and permissions as JSON. |
